description: This file defines an abstract class 'ChannelOwner' which manages communication channels, event subscriptions, and API call instrumentation within the Playwright core library. It includes methods for managing event listeners, creating proxy channels, wrapping API calls with tracing, and disposing of resources.

classes.name: ChannelOwner
classes.description: An abstract class managing communication channels, event subscriptions, and API call instrumentation for Playwright's internal architecture.

methods.name: _setEventToSubscriptionMapping
methods.description: Sets the mapping between event names and subscription identifiers.

methods.name: _updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription status for a given event.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'on' to manage subscriptions when listeners are added.

methods.name: _adopt
methods.description: Adopts a child ChannelOwner, updating parent-child relationships.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the channel and its children, cleaning up references.

methods.name: _debugScopeState
methods.description: Returns debug information about the current scope state.

methods.name: _validatorToWireContext
methods.description: Creates a ValidatorContext for wire protocol validation.

methods.name: _createChannel
methods.description: Creates a proxy channel with validation and instrumentation.

methods.name: _wrapApiCall
methods.description: Wraps API calls with tracing, error handling, and logging.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON serialization to prevent issues with object printing.
